dedupe_keys.name: dgac monthly commercial air traffic in france airports routes airport pairs and carriers since 1990

description: France's civil aviation authority (DGAC) receives flight records for commercial public air transport from aerodrome operators and airlines and publishes monthly traffic series on data.gouv.fr. ASP_APT gives monthly commercial traffic of French aerodromes since 1990, detailed for those with at least one traffic unit (a thousand passengers or a hundred kilograms of freight or mail); ASP_LSN gives traffic by segment, route group and country link; ASP_PAP gives traffic between airport pairs since 1990 for links above 10,000 passenger equivalents with at least three operators, none above 85 per cent; and ASP_CIE gives traffic by carrier since 2010. Coverage is national, including overseas territories. The data are free under the Licence Ouverte 2.0 and available to download as zipped CSV series with PDF notes describing the fields; files are updated annually three months after the end of the year, and the current series run to the end of 2025. Caveats: small airports, links and carriers below the thresholds are aggregated, and statistical confidentiality rules remove some airport pairs. The series support air network flow and capacity studies of French airports and analysis of traffic changes over three decades. They complement the EUROCONTROL data and the UK CAA airport statistics.
name: DGAC monthly commercial air traffic in France (airports, routes, airport pairs and carriers, since 1990)
provider: Direction générale de l'Aviation civile (DGAC), France
